Would removing the ability to downvote affect Voat for the better, the worse, or would it not change anything at all? I'm interested to hear everyone's opinions on the topic.

I agree that removing downvotes could make Voat for the better, and it would mean that people cannot simply censor others because they disagree with their opinions and/or beliefs. Like you said, it might make people actually comment and discuss things.

However, if downvoting is ever to be removed, a new system would need to be implemented to report spammers (such as a report comment/post system) or else we possibly solve one problem but allow an already existing one to become worse.

They effectively tried doing that in this sub (set the CCP to downvote to 500). It worked very well, except for the shitposting trolls who upvoted each other and buried the front page in crap. Coupled with deletes/bans, this would be fine - there needs to be some form of moderation, either in the form of downvotes or deletes/bans. In theory so long as the number of legitimate users is larger than the number of trolls, the system will work. In practice legitimate users upvote maybe one thread in ten (or maybe only 10% of legitimate users upvote threads), whereas the trolls being more motivated upvote 100% of their threads; ergo you need about 10x as many legitimate users to keep decent content on the front page. For whatever reason, legitimate users seem to be far more willing to downvote a shitpost.

Huh, never knew they tried something like that before here.
